recovered_coordinates.XData: axial or swirl velocity in m/s, not the spatial coordinate
recovered_coordinates.streamwise: axes title X/D, positive downstream from propeller centre
recovered_coordinates.radial_grid: 100 stored model rows, r/R from 0 to 1.5 in 99 intervals; original binary64 values retained
recovered_coordinates.cartesian_conversion: Once diameter, axis and signed spin are bound: downstream=(X/D)*D and radial_distance=(r/R)*R. A declared axisymmetric local frame can use receiver=(downstream,radial_distance,0); literal historical sensor azimuth/sign is not recovered.
recovered_coordinates.swirl_axis: All 18 ASW swirl series have an unavailable first value at r/R=0; keep unavailable, never replace by zero or a pass.
recovered_coordinates.axial_total: P5 stored axial tails are 5.486400000000001 or 12.192 m/s, consistent with total axial velocity. Current jet_velocity returns increments, so total-velocity reconstruction must explicitly add freestream and bind original sensor convention.

attribution.ASW: First axis explicitly labelled ASW; other axes bound by identical color/LineStyle/order to that legend; report captions identify ASWING 5.96.
attribution.ASW_m: Separate modified hub-core model, not an acceptance target for the unchanged ASWING component; source lines 1113–1119 describe modification but give no numeric hub size/mixing rule.
attribution.Exp: Digitized Deters experimental evidence only, not archived-ASWING acceptance targets; all curves retained separately.

source_cautions: P4 report calls five locations but omits 2.0 from its bracketed list; FIG titles recover all five including2.0.
Report line1077 says radial extent1.5 diameters, whereas FIG y-axis says r/R. Use saved labelled coordinates; do not double the radius based on prose.
P4 B filename versus APC report contradiction remains unresolved; no relabelling or diameter/RPM guess.

HG properties/ApplicationData expose layout, labels and series, no physical parameter tuple. hgM/meta_data/__function_workspace__ contain opaque MCOS content not exhaustively decoded; absence of hidden parameters is not proved.
Binary64 figure samples are not original text tokens. No historical decimal precision or strict acceptance threshold has been reconstructed.

The current jet_profile code explicitly uses corrected angular-momentum integrals relative to printed Eq138. Without the missing MATLAB/source bench, operator equivalence cannot be asserted or manufactured by fitting.

current_api.jet_profile: lines 109–137: engine axial_velocity,delta_velocity,radius,thrust,torque + downstream,density -> radii and axial/swirl increments
current_api.jet_velocity: lines 140–167: points, engine position/axes/jet_enabled, wind direction and density -> vector increments
current_api.executable_route: Existing isolated component API supports unmodified axial/swirl field once inputs and signed projection are supplied; no aircraft equilibrium required.
current_api.legacy_distinction: P4 targets are MATLAB model reproductions. P5 targets are report-attributed ASWING sensor-derived curves. Neither is currently an exact native table+driver pairing.

next_adapter.preferred: P5_A_GWS unmodified ASW: 8 series / 800 slots / 796 finite; strongest recovered propeller+RPM+ratio identity and an attributed ASWING sensor bench.
required_recovery: Obtain original sensor bench .asw/.sh or independent parameter record for power,density,CdA,actualV,spin and sensor orientation.
Bind total axial velocity and tangential sign/projection to original sensor channels; preserve axis NaNs.
Declare binary64 figure comparison policy separately from printed-table precision; do not widen tolerances to obtain agreement.
For P4 additionally recover MATLAB script/formulation; resolve second propeller identity. Keep ASW-m and experiments separate.
next_adapter.blocked_inventory_scope: Can now enumerate all 36 unmodified ASW curves, 3,600 slots / 3,582 finite and 18 unavailable without promoting any to an executable pass.
next_adapter.prohibited_shortcuts: Do not infer power,CdA,density from ASW velocity targets; that would make the comparison circular. Nominal diameter/RPM or experimental measured power alone do not prove the exact historical setup.
